title: FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
abstract: arXiv:2610.40560v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automated computational science could accelerate discovery by selecting, adapting and developing numerical methods. This prospect requires mathematical knowledge that AI systems can interpret and reuse with explicit guarantees. Here we present FARMS, a faithful and efficient foundation that transforms computational mathematics into AI-ready computing knowledge. FARMS connects formal statements to source context, algorithmic meaning and quantitative guarantees through source preparation, reusable representations and semantic review. Across 171 targets in randomized numerical linear algebra and numerical partial differential equations, 157 were accepted by the pipeline, with mean estimated costs of US \$0.85-2.29 per target across sources. Lean-checked implications from explicit source premises connect selected statements to computational skills, illustrated by a heat-flow solve and wave-response compression. translated_abstract: 自动化计算科学可以通过选择、调整和开发数值方法来加速科学发现。这一前景需要AI系统能够在明确保证下进行解释和复用的数学知识。本文提出FARMS，一个忠实且高效的基础框架，可将计算数学转化为AI就绪的计算知识。FARMS通过源准备、可复用表示和语义审查，将形式化命题与源上下文、算法含义及定量保证相连接。在随机数值线性代数和数值偏微分方程领域的171个目标中，有157个被该流程接受，各来源的平均估计成本为每个目标0.85至2.29美元。基于显式源前提的、经Lean验证的推论将所选命题与计算技能相连接，并通过热流求解和波响应压缩两个实例加以说明。因此，FARMS支持一种……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: FARMS是一个忠实、高效且可验证的基础框架，通过源准备、可复用表示和语义审查，将计算数学转化为经Lean验证的AI就绪计算知识，并将形式化命题与计算技能相连接，从而为自动化计算科学奠定基础。
